Project Overview

Mapped Zara’s online shopping experience in UXPressia during a one-week design project. Used the research to identify an interaction to improve and prototyped the redesign in Adobe XD. Project responsibilities included responsive design and cross-browser testing. Documented the findings, design decisions, and prototype in a Medium case study and short video presentation.
